offices.name: Quaestor
offices.description: Keeper of accounts and stores. The first rung of the ladder, and the last one where honest work is expected.

offices.name: Aedile
offices.description: Master of streets, markets, and games. Spends his own fortune on spectacles so the people remember his name.

offices.name: Praetor
offices.description: Judge and, when the year demands it, general. Holds imperium — the right to command in the field.

offices.name: Censor
offices.description: Counter of citizens and judge of morals. Can strike a man from the rolls with a stroke of the stylus.

offices.name: Pontifex Maximus
offices.description: Highest priest of the state cults. The gods speak through him — which makes him very hard to argue with.

offices.name: Consul
offices.description: One of the two heads of the Republic for a year. Armies, honors, and enemies follow the office.
